scenes.title: WHAT COMES NEXT?
scenes.say: Two, six, twelve, twenty, thirty. What comes next? Hint: look at the gaps.
Forty two! The gaps grow by two each time: four, six, eight, ten, then twelve. Thirty plus twelve is forty two.
Comment genius if you got it, and follow for tomorrow's puzzle.
